name: gsd-browser
description: Native Chrome/Chromium browser automation for Codex agents.

interface.longDescription: Adds the gsd-browser skill to Codex so agents can drive Chrome or Chromium through the native gsd-browser CLI: navigation, clicking, typing, screenshots, snapshots with refs, assertions, extraction, visual diffs, network controls, and live viewer workflows.
